purpose: Reject a possibility as inconsistent with your knowledge.
keywords: Plain clause + はずがない; noun + のはずがない.
There is no way that person would forget a promise.
It cannot possibly finish this quickly.
It is Sunday, so there cannot be school today.
formation: Plain clause + はずがない; noun + のはずがない.
restrictions: A strong personal judgment, rather than independent proof of impossibility.
mistake: It means cannot reasonably be so, not must not do it.
